_comment: The playlists songs can be sorted into, in two levels. Each song is placed in the most specific entry that fits; a subgenre only becomes its own playlist once it has enough songs (or already exists), otherwise its songs go into the parent. 'id' is how a playlist is recognised on later runs: rename freely, but changing an id makes a new playlist. 'hint' tells the model what belongs there.

genres.name: K-Pop
genres.hint: pop, hip hop and R&B from the Korean music industry (idol groups, Korean soloists)

genres.name: J-Pop
genres.hint: pop and rock from the Japanese music industry, anime songs, city pop
